Unit and Conversion Calculator

A unit and conversion calculator converts measurements between Metric and Imperial systems across physical dimensions—length, weight, volume, area, speed, and temperature—alongside practical utilities for international shoe size charts and foreign currency conversions. It ensures quick conversions without memorizing conversion factors.

Formula and Calculation Method

Key Unit Conversion Factors:

  • Length: 1 inch = 2.54 cm | 1 meter = 3.28084 feet | 1 mile = 1.60934 km
  • Weight / Mass: 1 pound (lb) = 0.453592 kg | 1 kg = 2.20462 lbs | 1 ounce = 28.3495 grams
  • Temperature: °C = (°F - 32) × 5/9 | °F = (°C × 9/5) + 32 | K = °C + 273.15
  • Volume: 1 US Gallon = 3.78541 Liters | 1 US Fluid Ounce = 29.5735 mL

Note on Currency vs Inflation: The Currency Converter tab on this page converts amounts between different world currencies at current exchange rates. If you want to calculate how purchasing power changes over time due to economic inflation, use our separate Currency and Inflation Calculator.

Worked Example and Step-by-Step Calculation

Multi-Unit Conversions Example
Input Values:
  • Length: 5 miles to kilometers
  • Temperature: 68° Fahrenheit to Celsius
  • Weight: 165 pounds to kilograms

1. Length: 5 miles × 1.609344 = 8.0467 km

2. Temperature: (68°F - 32) × 5/9 = 36 × 5/9 = 20.0°C

3. Weight: 165 lbs × 0.45359237 = 74.84 kg

Result: 5 miles = 8.05 km | 68°F = 20.0°C | 165 lbs = 74.84 kg

How to Use the Unit and Conversion Calculator

  1. Choose your tool tab: General Units (#general-units), Currency Converter (#currency-converter), or Shoe Sizes (#shoe-size-converter).
  2. Select the measurement dimension (Length, Weight, Temp, Volume, Area).
  3. Select your source unit and destination unit.
  4. Enter the numeric value to see conversions update instantly as you type.

Common Mistakes, Limitations & Practical Guidance

  • Shoe size conversion tables vary between footwear manufacturers; shoe width (narrow, medium, wide) also impacts physical fit.
  • Foreign currency rates fluctuate continuously during open global forex trading hours.

Frequently Asked Questions About Unit and Conversion Calculator

What is the difference between this Currency Converter and the Inflation Calculator?

The Currency Converter on this page converts amounts between world currencies (such as USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, JPY) at current exchange rates. Our Currency and Inflation Calculator measures how domestic purchasing power erodes over years due to price inflation.

How do you convert Fahrenheit to Celsius in your head?

A fast mental math shortcut: subtract 30 from the Fahrenheit temperature, then divide by 2. For example, 70°F minus 30 = 40; 40 ÷ 2 = ~20°C (exact is 21.1°C).

Why are US gallons different from UK Imperial gallons?

A US liquid gallon is defined as 231 cubic inches (approx. 3.785 liters), whereas an Imperial gallon used historically in the UK and Canada is defined as 10 pounds of distilled water (approx. 4.546 liters), making the UK gallon roughly 20% larger.

How do international shoe sizes correspond between US, UK, and EU?

Generally, US men's sizes are roughly 1 size larger than UK sizes (a US 10 is a UK 9), and correspond to EU 43-44. US women's sizes are roughly 2 sizes larger than UK sizes (a US 8 is a UK 6 / EU 38-39).

Are scientific conversion factors rounded in this calculator?

Calculations use official NIST exact definitions (e.g. 1 inch is defined as exactly 25.4 mm), rounding results to 6 significant digits to balance engineering accuracy with readability.
